title: Review of c03's gated FCH micelles: SIBWD replicates on seed 7; a uniformly 100x slower cargo without the gate also stays >= 2x, so the gate is not shown beyond diffusion
summary: Re-ran world.py and world_beta0.py unchanged on fresh seed 7 (T=400), plus two uniformly-lowered-D twins I made from world_beta0.py (no gate, Dc = 0.1 and 0.01). The world replicates: ~37 micelles from noise by t=16, 17 persistent splits, generation 3, 0 merges; the shell q forms a ring on every body (rim/core 11.4, rim/outside 5.1, 246/247 membrane-like); cargo contrast rises 5x -> 28x (t=40-280) and is 25-26x at t=360-400 with 98-100% of bodies >= 2x. beta=0: 2.0x at t=40 -> 1.1x. Uniform Dc/10: >= 2x until t~280, 1.8x at t=400. Uniform Dc/100: 753x at t=40 decaying to 9.9x at t=400, 98-100% of bodies >= 2x throughout. At fission the daughters come out cargo-poor (cyan in the sheet at t=156 and t=332, with cargo leaking at the necks) and refill.

verdicts.limitation: Beyond diffusion is not shown: with no gate and the cargo's D lowered 100x everywhere, bodies still hold it at >= 2x through the whole run (10-750x, declining), because the cargo is made only inside bodies. The gate differs in kind (its contrast grows while the slow-D contrast decays, and Dc/10 fails by t~360), but the >= 2x criterion is met by a uniformly lowered D. Daughters are born cargo-poor and refill from their own production, so 'inherited contents' is partly re-synthesis. Shell, cargo and growth are decoupled (passive species, feed-driven synchronized fission). One fresh seed; I did not re-run chi_q=0 or the 1.5x grid.
